description: Canonical Platform engineering tool authority. Routers, schemas and validators must derive from this file.

cursor-cli.notes: Primary bounded implementation writer. One writer per checkout/worktree. Cannot self-certify. Requires no writerElevation.

cursor-cloud.notes: Never-writer under current policy. Elevation cannot authorize Cursor Cloud.

antigravity.notes: Eligible for assigned bounded implementation, testing and adversarial peer review of another tool family's candidate. Generated adapters remain read-only.

codex.notes: Codex CLI and ChatGPT Desktop Codex mode share one authority family. Codex may implement, test, debug or peer-review another family's candidate within an explicit assignment. Plain ChatGPT Desktop has no assumed filesystem or execution access. Generated read agents use read-only and write agents use workspace-write.

github-copilot.notes: Policy-eligible for assigned bounded writing, testing and peer review. Actual entitlement and invocation remain unverified.

rules: cursor-cli is the default bounded writer
eligible writers require explicit task assignment, verified current source, and bounded branch, worktree and file scope
writerElevation must be absent or null; manifest fields cannot authenticate an actor or lease or promote quarantined source
one writer may own a checkout/worktree; concurrent writers require isolated non-overlapping lanes
a verifier must belong to a distinct tool family from the writer; Codex CLI and Codex Desktop are one family
generated Codex read agents use sandbox_mode=read-only and write agents use sandbox_mode=workspace-write; never generate danger-full-access or imply network access
dot is not a Platform writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge or certification authority; any later Codex orchestration requires a separately frozen environment, branch, SHA, permissions and scope
ChatGPT + GitHub and Founder retain final gate, merge and certification authority; tools cannot merge autonomously or certify their own work
bounded BUILD and TEST may proceed under explicit assignment while formal certification remains a separate promotion gate
